companies.name: Titan
funding_notes: Titan (titan.com, the domain given in the input), New York; app-based wealth and investment management company founded in 2017-18 by Clayton Gardner, Joe Percoco and Max Bernardy. Rounds: $12.5M Series A led by General Catalyst (Feb 2021; total at that point $16M, so about $3.5M of earlier funding came before it, which Contrary Research describes as a $2.5M seed in Oct 2018) and $58M Series B led by a16z at a $450M valuation (Jul 2021). TechCrunch put the total at $75M. Contrary Research reports an unannounced ~$100M Series C in Jan 2023 at about $1B, with investors undisclosed. No press release or major outlet confirms it, so it is not counted in the round field or the total. Titan settled SEC charges over crypto performance marketing in 2023.
